doc: Shallow history (region Shallow) and deep history (region Deep) side by side in one state. Both are the regions' initializers; Deep's is also the explicit target of two transitions.

steps.doc: No history yet: both default transitions run, each when its region is reached.
Exit in reverse document order: the lower region first.
Shallow restores S1 only (S1 starts at S11 again); deep restores the leaf D122 and everything above it. Default transitions do not run.
Leaving D1 inside On records nothing: history is recorded only when On itself is exited.
Explicit transition to the deep-history pseudo-state restores what was recorded when On was last exited.
Shallow rests in its final state: its record (S2) is forgotten.
Shallow follows its default transition again; Deep still restores D11.
Off to the deep-history pseudo-state: On is entered, Shallow by default (its own history), Deep from its record.
